---
title: "How to combine 1 question at a time with skip logic"
description: "Combine a survey shown 1 question at a time with questions that depend on earlier answers."
---

Combine a survey shown 1 question at a time with questions that depend on earlier answers.

The example in this guide is *One question at a time, with skip logic*. The skip-logic survey shown one question at a time, so each respondent sees only the questions that apply to them.

## In SurveyStudio

1. In RStudio, open the **Addins** menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `conversational_branching`.
2. Open **Survey settings**. On **General**, **Presentation mode** is Conversational. On **Design**, the dependent question has a branching rule.
3. On **Preview**, answer the first question in different ways. A question hidden by its rule is stepped over, so the respondent moves straight to the next question that applies.

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("conversational_branching")
sframe_get_branches(d$instrument)
export_survey(d$instrument, "survey.html")
```
